entries.note: The rhetorical question counts as endorsed because the next paragraph answers it: "They're not." There is no shared measure of "investing heavily" in robustness for a loosely defined group of managers.

entries.test: Industry surveys of how many engineers use AI-generated code, plus security and quality studies (e.g. vulnerability rates in AI-written code in production codebases) at companies that have cut staff.
entries.note: There is no deadline, but the evaluation date is two years after the post, so existing adoption and code-quality evidence can settle it. The drafter rightly dropped the rhetorical tail ("in ways I'm not sure people are capable of understanding").
